Cluster validation and review

Evidence supports review, not automatic validation. No event is reassigned. All frequencies refer to the saved clustering cohort. Five refits are an exploratory screen, not a definitive stability assessment.

Cluster evidence summary

Click a row to select a cluster. Missing metrics are not zero. Valid repeats count only successful fits with enough reference-cluster events.

Stability under refitting

Best Jaccard match for each reference cluster on shared retained events. Labels in refits are local identifiers. Points are repeats, not confidence intervals.

Sampled silhouette

Stratified subset, with rare clusters represented. Distances are in clustering-marker space. Values are approximate for the cohort; singleton subset values are zero by convention.

Signed marker profiles

Median and interquartile range, using all clustered events. Transformed/corrected units; no new scaling.

Marker distribution comparison

Density estimate from up to 2,000 fixed sampled events per cluster; bandwidth selected separately per curve. Shapes suggest review, not proof of subpopulations.

Marker enrichment / expression

Profile distances

Euclidean distance between cluster medians on clustering markers. Small distance alone does not justify merging.

Per-file frequency by condition

Each point is a file; zero-count clusters are included. The denominator is that file's clustered events. Batch association does not establish an artifact.

Review decisions

Decisions are drafts only. Export the CSV to preserve them; the HTML cannot append to the R log. No labels change until an explicit later import/application step.
